title: Child marriage before 18, LDCs, LLDCs and SIDS compared with the World, by location
headline: Since 2005, child marriage has fallen 11.5 points in LDCs, 8.7 in LLDCs and 3.7 in SIDS
subtitle: Percentage of women (aged 20-24 years) married or in union before age 18
years: LDCs: from 46.5% in 2005 to 35.0% in 2025. World: from 24.2% to 18.5%.
data_line: Data: UNICEF via UN SDG Global Database, series SP_DYN_MRBF18, extracted 1 Nov 2026
alt: Since 2005, child marriage has fallen 11.5 points in LDCs, 8.7 in LLDCs and 3.7 in SIDS. LDCs: from 46.5% in 2005 to 35.0% in 2025. World: from 24.2% to 18.5%. LDCs: 46.5% in 2005 to 35.0% in 2025; LLDCs: 40.0% in 2005 to 31.3% in 2025; SIDS: 25.5% in 2005 to 21.8% in 2025; World: 24.2% in 2005 to 18.5% in 2025
question: What lies behind the change in child marriage in Least developed countries, and what could others learn from it?
